name: std::span<T,Extent>::operator[]
intro: Returns a reference to the idxth element of the sequence. The behavior is undefined if idx is out of range (i.e., if it is greater than or equal to size()).

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
idx

 -

 the index of the element to access

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: A reference to the idxth element of the sequence, i.e., data()[idx].

summary: Returns a reference to the idxth element of the sequence. The behavior is undefined if idx is out of range (i.e., if it is greater than or equal to size()).
